title: Turn Figma Designs Into Working Code With Claude Code
description:
This one's a must for anyone doing real software development with designers on their team: the Figma plugin for Claude Code. It lets you load in Figma documents and have Claude build them out for you. 

So when a designer hands you a Figma file, you load it in and Claude Code creates the whole thing. In the demo I asked it to build a full working version in HTML and CSS and let it pick the approach, and the result came out practically identical to the original Figma design.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programming

I made my own website from scratch with a buddy of mine. I didnt know how to code, but my friend was kind of enough to walk me through the basics. Oh, sorry: a 'friend' is another person who enjoys your company and wants to hang out with you. Anyway it took us a few days, but Im now the proud owner of a self-hosted website completely customized to my liking. Comm and contact info, pricing, interactive examples of my work, etc. Plus, it was a good excuse to hang out with my buddy. I think of him every time I see it. Rest in peace, bro
Or you could press the generate website button that looks like everything else. I guess you dont have any friends?
